ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Advice delivery, Fact find and later stages need Adviser and Advice topic.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CASE(Stage__c, "Fact find", 1, "Analysis", 2, "Report drafted", 3, "Report issued", 4, "Accepted", 5, "Completed", 6, 0) >= 1, OR(ISBLANK(Adviser__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Advice_topic__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Adviser and Advice topic before moving to Fact find.
